data.name: Cabs Of Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Cabs of Chaos is a fast-paced, competitive, ride-share racing game where players are tasked to pick up and deliver passengers in the fastest and most chaotic ways possible. 

One Passenger, Four Players

Four drivers are all racing to pick up the same passenger and deliver them to their destination. But beware—other players can steal your passenger! If you're in the lead, you’ll need sharp reflexes to dodge incoming hits from other players and hold onto your fare until reaching the drop-off point.

Multiple Game Modes

While the Chaos mode is the way the game is meant to be played, other game-modes, minigames and modifiers allow you to mix up the party and change up the rules. 

In Classic Mode you're on your own and racing against the clock to keep the game going. Pick up passengers to gain time and deliver them as fast as possible! How long can you last before the timer runs out?

In Taxi Tag, the passenger is your worst nightmare and you want to get rid of them as fast as possible by passing them off to another player. Use your skills to dodge and weave as you try to be the driver with the least amount of time carrying them.

Lots more game modes to come!

Full Roster Of Characters

A colorful and comedic cast of characters brings the energy of a Saturday morning cartoon to life. With a fully voiced roster, pick your favorite driver and take their unique vehicle for a spin.

Multiple Ways To Play

Cabs of Chaos lets you dive into the action solo against bots, locally in split-screen with friends, or in a lobby with your friends online.

You can mix and match any combination of players—team up with local friends in split-screen while going head-to-head with others online for chaotic multiplayer fun with up to four players!

data.short_description: Race against rival drivers in a fast-paced, chaotic competition to find and deliver passengers before the clock runs out. Whether playing solo, split-screen, or online, navigate the city and find the most creative ways to crash, dash, and outmaneuver your opponents!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 4GB or Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
